  <script>
(function(root){
 'use strict';
 const KEY='runtime-sop-appearance-v1',doc=root.document,media=root.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
 const valid=value=>value==='light'||value==='dark'?value:null;
 function read(){try{return valid(root.localStorage.getItem(KEY));}catch(_){return null;}}
 let preference=read();
 function apply(){
  const theme=preference||(media.matches?'dark':'light'),html=doc.documentElement;
  html.dataset.theme=theme;html.style.colorScheme=theme;
  const meta=doc.querySelector('meta[name="color-scheme"]');if(meta)meta.content=preference||'light dark';
  for(const button of doc.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-choice]'))button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(button.dataset.themeChoice===(preference||'system')));
 }
 function choose(value){
  if(!['system','light','dark'].includes(value))return;
  preference=valid(value);
  try{if(preference)root.localStorage.setItem(KEY,preference);else root.localStorage.removeItem(KEY);}catch(_){}
  apply();
 }
 apply();
 doc.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
  for(const button of doc.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-choice]'))button.addEventListener('click',()=>choose(button.dataset.themeChoice));
  apply();
 },{once:true});
 media.addEventListener('change',()=>{if(!preference)apply();});
 root.addEventListener('storage',event=>{if(event.key===KEY||event.key===null){preference=read();apply();}});
})(globalThis);

</script>

values)tr.append(cell);decorateDepartment(tr,w.id);body.append(tr);}document.getElementById('empty-table').hidden=visible.length>0;
 document.getElementById('kpi-count').textContent=String(visible.length);document.getElementById('kpi-catalog').textContent=t('目录版本 {version}',{version:payload.catalog.version});const visibleIds=new Set(visible.map(w=>w.id));const history=(payload.historyEvents||[]).filter(e=>visibleIds.has(e.workflowId));const totals=visible.map(w=>aggregate?.workflows?.[w.id]).filter(Boolean);const hasAny=statsAvailable&&totals.some(x=>x&&x.views!==null);document.getElementById('kpi-views').textContent=hasAny?String(totals.reduce((n,x)=>n+(x?.views||0),0)):t('未采集');const fb=hasAny?totals.reduce((n,x)=>n+(x?.feedbackCount||0),0):null;document.getElementById('kpi-feedback').textContent=fb===null?t('未采集'):String(fb);
 const ratingSummary=document.getElementById('rating-summary');ratingSummary.replaceChildren();const rated=totals.filter(x=>x.ratings);for(const [i,label]of ratings().entries()){const value=rated.length?rated.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.ratings[i+1],0):null;ratingSummary.append(el('article',{class:'rating-total rating-'+(i+1)},[text('span',label),text('strong',unknown(value))]));}const legacy=totals.reduce((n,x)=>n+(x.ungradedRatings||0),0);document.getElementById('rating-definition').textContent=t('每台设备对同一 SOP 只计最新一次已发送评价。')+(legacy?t('当前筛选还有 {count} 条旧版赞踩未分档，不推算为五档评分。',{count:legacy}):t('旧版赞踩不推算为五档评分。'));
 const routeId=(()=>{try{return decodeURIComponent((location.hash.match(/^#sop=(.*)$/)||[])[1]||'');}catch(_){return '';}})();const detailHistory=routeId?(payload.historyEvents||[]).filter(h=>h.workflowId===routeId):history;
 const hist=document.getElementById('history');hist.replaceChildren();if(!detailHistory.length)hist.append(text('p',t('没有可验证的发布历史；历史记录上线前发生的更新数量未知。'),'history-empty'));else for(const h of detailHistory.slice().sort((a,b)=>String(b.publishedAt).localeCompare(String(a.publishedAt)))){const item=el('div',{class:'history-item'});item.append(text('strong',payload.workflows.find(x=>x.workflow.id===h.workflowId)?.workflow.title||h.workflowId),text('small',`${h.version||t('版本未记录')} · ${safeDate(h.publishedAt)} · ${h.previousSha256?t('已记录更新'):t('首次记录（更早历史未知）')}`));hist.append(item);}
 const metrics=document.getElementById('metrics-list');metrics.replaceChildren();if(!statsAvailable){metrics.append(text('p',t('尚无匿名设备统计文件；阅读、五档评价和文字反馈均为“未采集”，不是 0。'),'history-empty'));}else{for(const w of (routeId?workflows.filter(x=>x.id===routeId):visible)){const m=workflowMetrics(aggregate,w.id);const box=el('article',{class:'metric-block'});box.append(text('strong',w.title));const cards=el('div',{class:'metric-cards'});for(const [label,value,cls]of [[t('查看次数'),m?.views,''],...ratings().map((label,i)=>[label,m?.ratings?.[i+1],'rating-'+(i+1)]),[t('文字反馈'),m?.feedbackCount,'']])cards.append(el('div',{class:'metric-mini '+cls},[text('span',label),text('strong',unknown(value),value==null?'missing':'')]));if(m?.ungradedRatings)box.append(text('p',t('旧版未分档评价：')+m.ungradedRatings+t(' 条'),'muted'));box.append(cards);metrics.append(box);}}
 renderOverview(payload,visible,totals,rated,history);
 renderDepartments(payload);applyRoute(payload);return {payload,visible};}
function csvCell(v){let s=String(v??'');if(/^[=+@\-\t\r]/.test(s))s="'"+s;return '"'+s.replaceAll('"','""')+'"';}
function exportCsv(payload){const workflows=payload.workflows.map(x=>({...x.workflow,version:x.guide.version||x.version||t('版本未记录'),updatedAt:x.updatedAt||''}));const visible=sortRows(workflows,document.getElementById('search').value,document.getElementById('status-filter').value,document.getElementById('sort').value,payload.aggregate);const lines=[[t('名称'),'ID',t('状态'),t('查看器'),t('版本'),t('更新时间'),t('查看次数'),...ratings(),t('旧版未分档评价'),t('反馈数'),t('已记录更新')].map(csvCell).join(',')];for(const w of visible){const m=workflowMetrics(payload.aggregate,w.id);lines.push([w.title,w.id,w.status,w.viewer,w.version,w.updatedAt,m?.views??t('未采集'),...ratings().map((_,i)=>m?.ratings?.[i+1]??t('未采集')),m?.ungradedRatings??t('未采集'),m?.feedbackCount??t('未采集'),m?.updateCount??t('未追踪')].map(csvCell).join(','));}const blob=new Blob(['\ufeff'+lines.join('\r\n')],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}),a=el('a',{href:URL.createObjectURL(blob)});a.download=t('SOP-筛选总表.csv');a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);}
function openDb(){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const req=indexedDB.open(DB,1);req.onupgradeneeded=()=>req.result.createObjectStore(STORE);req.onsuccess=()=>resolve(req.result);req.onerror=()=>reject(req.error);});}
async function storeHandle(handle){const db=await openDb();return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const tx=db.transaction(STORE,'readwrite');tx.objectStore(STORE).put(handle,KEY);tx.oncomplete=()=>{db.close();resolve();};tx.onerror=tx.onabort=()=>{db.close();reject(tx.error);};});}
async function getHandle(){const db=await openDb();return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const tx=db.transaction(STORE,'readonly'),req=tx.objectStore(STORE).get(KEY);req.onsuccess=()=>{db.close();resolve(req.result||null);};req.onerror=()=>{db.close();reject(req.error);};});}
async function findSop(root){for(const paths of [[],['SOP'],[t('工作SOP'),'SOP'],['sop']]){try{let dir=root;for(const part of paths)dir=await dir.getDirectoryHandle(part);await dir.getFileHandle('catalog.json');return dir;}catch(e){if(e.name!=='NotFoundError')throw e;}}fail(t('请选择工作SOP或其SOP文件夹。'));}
async function readFile(root,path,limit=MAX_FILE){let dir=root;const parts=path.split('/');for(const p of parts.slice(0,-1))dir=await dir.getDirectoryHandle(p);const f=await(await dir.getFileHandle(parts.at(-1))).getFile();if(f.size>limit)fail(t('文件超过读取上限：')+path);return await f.text();}
async function sha(raw){const h=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',new TextEncoder().encode(raw));return Array.from(new Uint8Array(h),b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');}
async function readKnownJson(dir,accept,totalRef,budget){const result=[];for await(const [name,handle]of dir.entries()){if(handle.kind!=='file'||!name.endsWith('.json')||!accept.test(name))continue;if(++budget.count>MAX_CLIENTS)fail(t('已知历史/统计 JSON 文件超过 1000 个安全上限。'));const raw=await handle.getFile().then(async f=>{if(f.size>MAX_FILE)fail(t('单个统计/历史文件超过 2 MB。'));totalRef.size+=f.size;if(totalRef.size>MAX_TOTAL)fail(t('所选目录数据超过 32 MB 读取上限。'));return f.text();});result.push({name,raw:await raw});}return result;}
async function readLive(handle){const Engine=globalThis.CatalogEngine,Stats=globalThis.StatsEngine,Remote=globalThis.RemoteContent;if(!Engine||!Stats)fail(t('目录或统计校验器未载入。'));const rawCatalog=await readFile(handle,'catalog.json',512*1024);const catalog=Engine.validateCatalog(JSON.parse(rawCatalog));const total={size:new TextEncoder().encode(rawCatalog).length},workflows=[],historyEvents=[],budget={count:0};
 for(const w of catalog.workflows){const raw=await readFile(handle,w.file);total.size+=new TextEncoder().encode(raw).length;if(total.size>MAX_TOTAL)fail(t('目录和正文合计超过 32 MB。'));if(await sha(raw)!==w.sha256)fail(t('工作流 {id} SHA-256 不匹配。',{id:w.id}));let parsed=JSON.parse(raw);if(parsed.format==='runtime-sop-document')parsed=await globalThis.SOPAssets.hydrate(parsed,w,async path=>{const parts=path.split('/');let dir=handle;for(const part of parts.slice(0,-1))dir=await dir.getDirectoryHandle(part);const file=await(await dir.getFileHandle(parts.at(-1))).getFile();if(file.size>4*1024*1024)fail(t('图片超过4MB。'));total.size+=file.size;if(total.size>MAX_TOTAL)fail(t('所选内容超过32MB。'));return new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());});let guide;if(w.viewer==='guide'){guide=Engine.validateGuide(parsed);if(guide.workflowId!==w.id)fail(t('指南身份与目录不匹配。'));}else{if(!Remote)fail(t('YouTube 内容校验器未载入。'));const b=await globalThis.SOPSync.verify(parsed);guide=youtubeSubset(b,w);}workflows.push({workflow:w,guide,version:guide.version});}
 try{const histRoot=await handle.getDirectoryHandle('publication-history');for(const w of catalog.workflows){try{const wfDir=await histRoot.getDirectoryHandle(w.id);const items=await readKnownJson(wfDir,/^[a-f0-9]{64}\.json$/i,total,budget);for(const {name,raw}of items){const e=Stats.validateHistoryEvent(JSON.parse(raw));if(e.workflowId!==w.id||name.toLowerCase()!==e.sha256+'.json')fail(t('发布历史文件名/身份不匹配。'));historyEvents.push(e);}}catch(e){if(e.name!=='NotFoundError')throw e;}}}catch(e){if(e.name!=='NotFoundError')throw e;}
 const snapshots=[];let statisticsAvailable=false;try{const stats=await handle.getDirectoryHandle('statistics');const clients=await stats.getDirectoryHandle('clients');const files=await readKnownJson(clients,/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}\.json$/i,total,budget);for(const {name,raw}of files){const value=Stats.validateSnapshot(JSON.parse(raw));if(name.toLowerCase()!==value.clientId.toLowerCase()+'.json')fail(t('设备统计文件名与匿名 ID 不匹配。'));snapshots.push(value);}statisticsAvailable=snapshots.length>0;}catch(e){if(e.name!=='NotFoundError')throw e;}
 for(const item of workflows)item.updatedAt=historyEvents.filter(e=>e.workflowId===item.workflow.id).sort((a,b)=>b.publishedAt.localeCompare(a.publishedAt))[0]?.publishedAt||null;
 const categories=await globalThis.SOPCategoryStore.read(handle);total.size+=new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(categories)).length;if(total.size>MAX_TOTAL)fail(t('所选目录数据超过 32 MB 读取上限。'));if(await readFile(handle,'catalog.json',512*1024)!==rawCatalog)fail(t('当前没有该目录的读取授权；请重新选择文件夹并授权。'));return {catalog,workflows,historyEvents,statisticsAvailable,aggregate:Stats.aggregate(snapshots,historyEvents),categories,source:'live',loadedAt:new Date().toISOString()};}
function youtubeSubset(bundle,workflow){const cfg=bundle.config;return {workflowId:workflow.id,title:workflow.title,version:bundle.contentVersion||cfg.version,notice:'YouTube SOP 正文从已验证内容包的 config 子集读取；图解素材保持在本地阅读器中。',steps:cfg.steps.map(s=>({id:s.id,title:s.title,where:s.locationHint,actions:s.actions,expected:(s.outputs||[]).join('\n'),acceptance:s.acceptance||[],trouble:s.gateHint||'',issues:[],...(s.id==='YT03'&&bundle.assets?.studioScreenshot?{imageData:'data:'+bundle.assets.studioScreenshot.mimeType+';base64,'+bundle.assets.studioScreenshot.data}:{})}))};}
async function chooseSource(){if(connectedMode){window.open(chrome.runtime.getURL('options.html'),'_blank','noopener');return;}if(!window.showDirectoryPicker)fail(t('此浏览器不支持原生文件夹选择。可继续查看内嵌总表，或用支持 File System Access API 的 Chrome 打开。'));const chosen=await window.showDirectoryPicker({mode:'read'});const sop=await findSop(chosen);await storeHandle(sop);const previousSource=sourceHandle;sourceHandle=sop;try{return await refreshLive(true);}catch(error){sourceHandle=previousSource;throw error;}}
async function refreshLive(fromClick=false){const ticket=++sourceEpoch;let h=connectedMode?await connectedHandle():sourceHandle||await getHandle();if(!h)fail(t('请先选择 存储器 的工作SOP或SOP文件夹。'));let permission=await h.queryPermission({mode:'read'});if(permission!=='granted'&&!connectedMode&&fromClick&&h.requestPermission)permission=await h.requestPermission({mode:'read'});if(permission!=='granted')fail(t('当前没有该目录的读取授权；请重新选择文件夹并授权。'));const payload=await readLive(h);if(connectedMode&&!await h.isSameEntry(await connectedHandle()))fail(t('当前没有该目录的读取授权；请重新选择文件夹并授权。'));if(ticket!==sourceEpoch)return;sourceHandle=h;current=validatePayload(payload);render(current);setStatus(()=>t('已从所选目录读取并验证目录、正文与现有统计。 最近检查：')+safeDate(current.loadedAt),'ok');document.getElementById('source-label').textContent=sourceLabel();if(autoTimer)clearInterval(autoTimer);if(connectedMode)return payload;autoTimer=setInterval(async()=>{try{const p=await h.queryPermission({mode:'read'});if(p!=='granted'){clearInterval(autoTimer);autoTimer=null;return;}const next=await readLive(h);current=validatePayload(next);render(current);setStatus(()=>t('已自动刷新。 最近检查：')+safeDate(current.loadedAt),'ok');}catch(e){setStatus(()=>t('自动刷新失败，仍保留上次已验证总表：')+e.message,'error');}},60000);return payload;}
let current=null,autoTimer=null,sourceHandle=null,sourceEpoch=0;
async function assertSelected(handle=sourceHandle){if(connectedMode&&(!handle||!await handle.isSameEntry(await connectedHandle())))fail(t('当前没有该目录的读取授权；请重新选择文件夹并授权。'));}
function invalidateConnected(){sourceEpoch++;sourceHandle=null;for(const id of ['detail-title','detail-meta','detail-summary','detail-body','detail-feedback','history','metrics-list'])document.getElementById(id)?.replaceChildren();for(const id of ['native-version-history','detail-link'])document.getElementById(id)?.removeAttribute('href');activeDepartment='';globalThis.SOPSharing?.close?.();for(const dialog of document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open]'))dialog.close();current=validatePayload(dataFromStatic());render(current);document.getElementById('source-label').textContent=t('未配置');setStatus('打开内容库以恢复文件夹连接','error');}

// Handoff contains metadata only. Shared relationships require their own explicit folder choice.
function updateRelationshipLinks(payload){
 let href=connectedMode?'relationships.html?source=connected':'relationships.html';
 if(payload&&Array.isArray(payload.workflows)&&payload.workflows.length<=500){
  const nodes=payload.workflows.map(item=>({id:item.workflow.id,title:item.workflow.title,stepCount:item.guide.steps.length}));
  href+='#seed='+encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({nodes,source:'dashboard'}));
 }
 for(const anchor of document.querySelectorAll('[data-relationship-link]')){anchor.href=href;if(payload)anchor.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');else anchor.setAttribute('aria-disabled','true');}
}
function bindRelationshipNavigation(){
 updateRelationshipLinks(null);
 for(const anchor of document.querySelectorAll('[data-relationship-link]')){
  const prepare=event=>{if(!current){event.preventDefault();setStatus('正在核验内嵌内容…');return;}updateRelationshipLinks(current);};
  for(const event of ['click','auxclick','contextmenu'])anchor.addEventListener(event,prepare);
 }
}

async function bindSource(handle,{refresh=true}={}){if(refresh){const payload=validatePayload(await readLive(handle));sourceHandle=handle;current=payload;render(current);}else sourceHandle=handle;return handle;}

async function init(){
 if(connectedMode){
  const saved=await chrome.storage.local.get(['runtime-sop-team-settings-v1','runtime-sop-workspace-preferences-v1']);
  if(saved['runtime-sop-team-settings-v1']?.enabled){location.replace(chrome.runtime.getURL('team-library.html'));return;}
  globalThis.DashboardI18n?.setLanguage(saved['runtime-sop-workspace-preferences-v1']?.language||'auto');
 }
 bindRelationshipNavigation();globalThis.DashboardI18n?.init();
 globalThis.DashboardI18n?.subscribe(()=>{if(current)render(current);if(lastStatus)setStatus(lastStatus.message,lastStatus.kind);document.getElementById('source-label').textContent=sourceHandle?sourceLabel():t('内嵌验证快照');globalThis.SOPCategoryUI?.localize?.();if(connectedMode)document.getElementById('choose-source').textContent=t('设置');});
 document.getElementById('dashboard-help').href=connectedMode?chrome.runtime.getURL('options.html'):'../docs/INSTALL.md';
 document.getElementById('dashboard-download').href='running-sop-extension-v'+document.getElementById('dashboard-download').dataset.version+'.zip';
 current=validatePayload(dataFromStatic());
 globalThis.SOPCategoryUI.init({getPayload:()=>current,getSource:()=>sourceHandle,resolveSource:findSop,bindSource,assertActive:connectedMode?assertSelected:null,connected:connectedMode,onChange:categories=>{current={...current,categories};render(current);},onSelect:id=>{activeDepartment=id;render(current);}});
 render(current);globalThis.SOPSharing?.init({getPayload:()=>current});
 document.getElementById('source-label').textContent=t('内嵌验证快照');
 setStatus(()=>t('当前显示生成时的数据。选择 存储器 文件夹后，可刷新并自动检查更新。'),'ok');
 if(connectedMode){document.getElementById('choose-source').textContent=t('设置');document.getElementById('dashboard-language').addEventListener('change',async()=>{const key='runtime-sop-workspace-preferences-v1',saved=await chrome.storage.local.get(key);await chrome.storage.local.set({[key]:{...saved[key],language:globalThis.DashboardI18n.getLanguage()}});});chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((changes,area)=>{if(area==='local'&&(changes['runtime-sop-catalog-settings-v1']||changes[globalThis.SOPStorageSource.KEY]||changes['runtime-sop-team-settings-v1']))invalidateConnected();});}
 for(const id of ['search','status-filter','sort'])document.getElementById(id).addEventListener(id==='search'?'input':'change',()=>render(current));
 document.getElementById('export-csv').addEventListener('click',()=>exportCsv(current));
 document.getElementById('choose-source').addEventListener('click',async e=>{const button=e.currentTarget;button.disabled=true;try{await chooseSource();}catch(err){setStatus(()=>err.message,'error');}finally{button.disabled=false;}});
 document.getElementById('refresh').addEventListener('click',async e=>{const button=e.currentTarget;button.disabled=true;try{await refreshLive(true);}catch(err){setStatus(()=>err.message,'error');}finally{button.disabled=false;}});
 window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>{render(current);document.querySelector('main').scrollTop=0;window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});});
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden){clearInterval(autoTimer);autoTimer=null;}else if(!connectedMode)refreshLive(false).catch(err=>setStatus(()=>t('重新打开页面后的自动检查失败：')+err.message,'error'));});
 try{const h=connectedMode?await connectedHandle():await getHandle();if(h)await refreshLive(false);}catch(e){if(connectedMode)setStatus(()=>e.message,'error');}
 document.documentElement.dataset.dashboardReady='true';
}


function showError(message){setStatus(()=>t('总表初始化失败：')+message,'error');}
return {MAX_CLIENTS,MAX_TOTAL,validatePayload,sortRows,csvCell,render,renderGuide,renderDetail,readLive,bindSource,init,showError,youtubeSubset};
});

</script>
</body>
</html>

Running SOP SOP 关系图ARCHIFY / SOP FLOW MAP
← 返回总表

尚未连接文件夹。可编辑和导出，保存共享关系前请明确选择 SOP 文件夹。

SOP 关系图

拖动节点柄移动 · 从右侧端口拉线到目标 SOP · 点击连线可删除
下一项 SOPISSUE 分支

选中的 SOP

仅显示标题与步骤数量；核验后不保留或展示步骤正文。

此 SOP 的后续连接

手动连接

直接从起点右侧圆点拖到终点；也可依次点击两个端口。

使用说明与保存范围

移动节点只改变排布；添加或删除有向连线，才会改变前后关系。选中拖动柄后，方向键微调，Shift 加方向键移动 10px。

节点采用内置 Archify SVG。移动只改变位置，下一项 SOP 与 ISSUE 连线单独保存。

共享关系单独保存在所选 SOP 文件夹的 relations.json；不会修改 SOP 正文或目录。保存需要写入授权，先检查修订号、备份旧版，再回读校验。未连接时只能编辑和导出。

动画可关闭，并尊重系统减少动态效果设置，页面隐藏时暂停。导入仅接受已验证的关系 JSON，不执行脚本或加载远程资源。

仅显示标题与步骤数量；核验后不保留或展示步骤正文。

替换当前脑图草稿？

导入仅替换当前页面的布局与连线；只关联当前已核验的 SOP。共享文件在明确保存前保持不变。可先导出备份。
